#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the
 Five
 Great
nesses

---


**
¶1:** Fals
ity and evil in
 their
 entire
ty were
 overcome
 by five degrees of divine operation proce
eding from the
 Infinite.


**¶2:** The first
 degree
 is the Divine
 Love
 itself, dwelling
 in its
 own infinite peace
 and incomp
rehensibility,
 established
 in the
 ground
 of its own being,
 r
esting in its own essence,
 from
 which all
 things proceed but
 which nothing
 external
 can approach
 or
 distur
b.

**¶3:**
 Four degrees
 of divine operation were
 made
 manifest and proceeded
 forth
 from the Divine Love. They
 were distributed
 into
 a
 full
ness of tru
ths, and established
 as
 the
 complete whole
 of
 faith and charity
 in
 their tot
ality —
 all
 things of the
 church from
 first
 to last.

**¶4
:** The second degree of
 divine operation p
oured forth
 and was made
 manifest;
 it was revealed from the Divine
 Love itself
. It is the Divine
 Truth
 that
 gives
 spiritual life —
 the great Divine
 Proce
eding —
 together
 with the
 Celest
ial Human
 in
 its first descent
 toward
 spiritual combat and
 the
 five
 interior
 faculties of the celestial mind that
 belong
 to it
.
 These
 constitute
 the second
 degree.


**¶5:** The third
 degree is the Divine Truth
 perceived
 in
 its beauty by
 the understanding, the Divine Power
 that structures and orders all
 spiritual states,
 the
 Divine Truth
 as
 it governs and exec
utes judgment, and
 the five
 ordering
 and
 sust
aining powers that
 proceed
 from it.
 These constitute
 the third degree.

**¶
6:** The fourth degree is the Divine
 Truth proceeding into the external and
 natural
 world to redeem what
 has been captured
,
 together
 with the sust
aining truth that connects the
 lowest
 states to the highest,
 and all
 the tru
ths that
 were
 revealed
 from it. These constitute the fourth degree
.

**¶7:** The
 fifth degree proce
eding from the Divine Love is the
 Divine Wisdom made
 fully
 manifest in rad
iant
 intelligibility, together
 with all
 the tru
ths and goods that it
 summ
oned
 forth
,
 the
 eman
ations that
 p
oured forth and were made manifest from it
.


**¶8:** This
 is the manner
 of
 their
 extension
 through
 all
 things in
 full
ness:
 the five interior
 faculties of the celestial mind perv
ade
 the entire spiritual structure from
 within
;
 and
 another
 five —
 the five governing principles of
 the ordering
 Divine
 Truth — are extended
 to five
 distinct
 states
 of
 spiritual life, sust
aining them
 from
 without
.

**¶9:** The
 whole
 is
 complete in the
 fullness of faith
 and charity.
 And
 there
 are two
 more added to
 them
:
 the divine
 calling
 and the reception
 of that
 calling.
 These
 are the good
 and the
 truth — the generating
 principles
 —
 which
 the
 Divine
 Wisdom at
 its
 coming
 appointed
 as
 its
 continuing
 presence
,
 so
 that the divine
 operation
 would
 persist
 in the
 ground
 of the
 natural
 mind and
 in all
 things within
 it.

**¶10:**
 The descent
 of the
 Celestial Human —
 who
 came
 forth
 from the Divine and
 existed
 in a state
 of sovereignty
 and honor
 before
 all
 the
 fac
ulties that
 belonged
 to its
 household
 — was
 such
 that ev
ils and falsities from
 the hells surrounded
 it
 and
 affl
icted it by
 their mal
ice.
 They
 stripped
 from
 it its
 goods
 and its
 abundance
 of
 truth
.
 They imprisoned it in bond
age and
 seized
 away
 its companion
 fac
ulties. Yet
 the
 Celestial Human end
ured by its
 humility, and took
 courage
 and rest
rained its
 advers
aries in silence and
 trust
.

**¶11:** Just
 as it
 is
 with
 a
 noble heir
 of
 a
 kingdom
 whose
 enemies close
 in
 around him
, so too was
 the descent
 of the Celestial Human into
 the
 sphere
 of the
 inf
ernal powers
 —
 the enemies
 of all
 wisdom
 and good
.


**¶12:** In
 contrast
, the coming
 of the governing
 Divine Truth and
 the commission
 it
 received, whereby
 it came
 upon
 all the powers
 of
 evil
 and falsity, differs
 from the descent of the Celestial
 Human.
 Its
 operation
 is not
 the patient
 end
urance of tem
ptation but the active
 exercise
 of judgment
.

**¶13:** The
 coming
 of the governing
 Divine Truth is of
 this
 nature:
 when it was
 sent forth
 from
 the Divine that
 it might raise
 up the
 Celestial Human from
 bond
age, it
 was like
 the principle
 of justice
 sent
 from
 the Divine
 Love
 to overt
urn the violence
 done
 to the noble
 heir
 against
 whom
 the powers
 of evil
 had sinned.
 And
 this
 principle
 of justice is u
nyiel
ding
 and
 implacable toward
 evil
,
 and by
 its righte
ousness and
 its
 power it gives
 the means
 of
 liberation
.
 It also judges every
 evil
 according to its own rebell
ious nature and
 renders
 to
 each according
 to its quality
.
 Those ev
ils that merit
 the
 infl
iction
 of suffering
 it
 strikes
 with the
 harsh
 correction
 of truth
.
 Those that
 merit
 the removal of their
 power
 to
 act it se
vers
 from
 their fac
ulties.
 It
 rep
ays each
 accordingly
.
 It
 binds and restra
ins them and
 susp
ends them in states
 of in
version
,
 and thus
 it deals
 with them by
 right
eous judgment.
 It puts
 them to
 spiritual
 death, str
ipping away even
 their
 ou
termost cov
erings of
 apparent
 truth
,
 so
 that they are
 utterly ext
inguished. And
 those
 from whom it is
 fitting
 to remove
 their states
 of
 hab
itation,
 it ban
ishes by
 right
eous judgment —
 in
 exact
 correspondence
 to the
 way
 they
 had
 sinned against
 the noble celest
ial principle
.

**¶14:** Also
, the subordin
ate truths and good
 aff
ections that serve this
 governing principle
 of
 justice,
 which
 belong
 to it
 in great
 power
 —
 in an instant they
 carry
 out the will
 of their
 ruling
 truth
,
 for
 in
 the
 spiritual world all
 operation
 of
 truth
 is immediate
.


**¶15:** Now
, just
 as this true
 principle
 of justice was
 sent
 from
 the Divine Love to overturn the violence
 done to the noble heir, so too
 the
 governing Divine Truth was
 sent from the Lord
 of
 all
 wisdom
 to
 overturn the cr
uelty and
 violence
 done to the
 Celestial Human,
 against
 whom
 the ruling
 power
 of all
 falsity from
 evil had sinned —
 both
 it
 and all
 its
 rebell
ious subordin
ate
 powers.
 Therefore
,
 when the governing Divine Truth came, it
 raised
 up the Celestial Human from bond
age.


**¶16:** Also,
 all the powers of evil and falsity
 that
 had sinned against the fac
ulties of the Celestial Human —
 the governing
 Divine
 Truth jud
ged them by
 right
eous judgment. It bound them in both
 interior
 and exterior states. It placed each
 evil
 in the
 state
 fitting
 for its
 nature
;
 it
 weighed each according
 to its cruelty and oppression
. Some
 it
 enclosed in states
 of con
finement from
 which they cannot
 emerge.
 Others it fixed
 in states of in
version,
 their
 understanding made
 subordin
ate to
 their
 evil
 will
. Some
 are
 rendered
 utt
erly power
less.
 Others are made
 to remain
 forever
 in their fixed
 condition
.
 Some
 among
 them are placed beneath
 their
 companions
, rest
rained by an
 un
breakable bond
 of
 truth
. Others were
 given
 domin
ion over lesser
 evils beneath
 them, so
 that they carry
 out their
 comp
uls
ions among
 those
 below them —
 for
 in hell
 each
 evil rules
 and
 is
 ruled according
 to its own nature.

**
¶17:** Know
 that when
 the Divine
 established
 these
 judgments, it was
 revealed
 to
 all
 the powers of fals
ity. It judged them as a
 true
 arb
iter of spiritual
 states
.
 This
 is the first judgment that
 the governing
 Divine Truth rendered
 upon
 the powers of evil in
 respect
 of
 the Celestial Human.
 It gave
 vind
ication to the Celestial Human in
 exact
 proportion
 to its
 suffering
;
 and
 it condemned
 the ruling power
 of all falsity in
 exact
 proportion to its transg
ression.

**¶18:**
 This
 bond
 of truth, of
 this
 nature, became
 the restra
int upon
 evil
 throughout the ground
 of the natural world
 until
 the final
 cons
ummation when
 all
 things of
 the natural order
 shall
 be dissolved —
 when
 all
 that
 is merely
 natural per
ishes in
 the consuming
 power
 of divine love and
 is
 separated.
 Then
 wisdom
 returns to its
 own
 heav
enly origin
, and fals
ity remains in restra
int and
 con
finement for et
ernity.

**¶19:**
 The coming
 also
 of the Divine
 Truth
 proce
eding into
 the external
 world,
 when
 it came
 to
 examine those
 goods
 and truths held
 captive in
 the intermediate
 spiritual states:
 it
 is
 like
 the supreme
 governing
 love
 that
 comes
 and
 insp
ects the fac
ulties that
 form
 tru
ths into use
.


**¶20:** And
 those
 faculties that
 are
 good —
 those
 that form
 truths and
 build
 spiritual
 structures
 and
 fashion
 the works
 of charity,
 which
 have
 been
 placed
 in their
 various
 functions
:
 the
 Divine
 sees
 that
 they have
 lab
ored well and have applied
 themselves
 to its
 purposes
 in
 their
 proper
 manner
. And the Divine rejo
ices with
 great
 delight.
 It
 acknowled
ges the form
ative fac
ulties that
 have constructed
 its spiritual
 works and fulfilled
 its ends
.

**¶21:** Now
, just as this supreme
 governing love comes
 and
 inspects its
 works
 and its
 structures
 of
 protection
, so also
 is
 the coming of the Divine Truth proceeding
 into the external world.
 For
 when it too
 came,
 it saw
 all
 spiritual
 structures
 established
 and prepared
 —
 the ordered
 arrangement of all states
 of evil
 rest
rained and
 held in place
,
 above
 and below, out
ward and inward, in the great
 pattern of
 divine
 order that
 its
 prior
 operations had made
.
 Those
 prior
 operations had come
 before
 it
 into
 the conflict
;
 they
 had fixed and formed the spiritual
 world
 before
 it arrived
. It
 saw the heav
enly powers and
 the ang
elic societies
 established
 and governing

 of order
,
 gu
arding

 divine

. These

 Proceeding that

:** Therefore, when it perceived

ed and

comp
ense you have given is

ioned
 —

red and

ained of

."

iant full

erate from

 Afterwards

anted true

 the

eness of the coming

ness.
 It happened

: it

 sovereign
 and

de
emer, and

orious intelligence
 it destroyed the

 It bound and crushed them as
 the

ys false

erly. This

 the form

olitional and

.

ation and

 the

 the divine

 —

gled with

ains all

ummation when

ate human.
 You

asts away from

ination

athers them in
ward

ected in

ummation of all merely

 —

ial good that

i
escent.

 natural

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first greatness is the Father of Greatness who exists in calm and hiddenness; as he is established in his light-earth, in his own essence.
Four greatnesses were manifested and came forth of him. They were appointed to ten parts, and established in total twelve.

The second greatness poured out and was manifested. It was revealed from the first greatness. It is the Mother of Life, the Great Spirit, together with the First Man and his five sons; these are the second greatness.
The third greatness is the Beloved of the Lights, the Great Builder, the Living Spirit, and the five sons of the Living Spirit. These are the third greatness.
The fourth greatness is the Third Ambassador, and the Pillar of Glory, and all the light powers who were revealed from him. These are the fourth greatness.
The fifth greatness who came from the Father is Jesus the Splendour, and all his powers whom he summoned, his emanations who were [sent forth from him.] They poured out and were manifested from him.

This is, so that they were spread out and [established in] fives: these five [sons] of the First Man [fill] the entire building; another five are the five sons of the Living Spirit who are spread out to five places, supporting [all things from without.]

[They are a] total in twelve parts that [make up the whole. There are] another two added to them who are the summons and the obedience. They are the father and the mother whom Jesus the Splendour by his advent has appointed as successors to his place [over] the great earth and the [life that dwells] in them.

[The advent also] of the First Man who came [to the contest: he resembles a noble son] belonging to [a great household,] existing in a kingdom [of] esteem before they who belong to his household[. Then] his enemies [surround him with affliction] and suffering by their wickedness; and they take from him [his goods] and a richness; and they imprison [him in] captivity and take from him their companies (?). Yet, he [endures] by his humility; and he takes heart and restrains his enemy [with patience] in silence.
Just as with this man, this noble son whose enemies surround him, this also is how the advent of the First Man happened, [when he descended among the] rulers, the enemies of the light.

In contrast, the advent of the Living Spirit and the commandment that he received, whereby he came upon all the rulers, it differs from that of the First Man. His advent [is not as] the advent of the First Man.
Also, the associates in the mystery and the assistants of this judge, these who belong to him in great strength; in an instant and haste they shall do the will of their master.

Now, just as this genuine judge, who was sent from the king to overturn the violence to this man, the noble son: this is also the case with the Living Spirit. He also was sent from the King of the lights to overturn the vengeance and violence to the First Man, against whom the King of the realms of Darkness had sinned. He faulted and sinned against him, and also his rebellious powers. Therefore, when (the Living Spirit) came, he bore up the First Man.

Also, all the rulers, the powers of sin who had faulted and sinned against the sons of the First Man, he has judged them according to a righteous judgement. He has bound them in heaven and earth. He put each one to the place fitting for him; he weighed each of them according to his cruelty and oppression. While some of them he enclosed in the prison, others he hung head down. Some [of them] are crucified, others are sat down all the time. Some among them are fixed beneath their associates, restricted by a strong chain; others he made the holders of authority over their companions beneath, so that they may do their pleasure amongst these below them.

Happen you know this [truth,] that when the Father of Life established the judgements [of righteousness,] He was revealed to all the powers of darkness. He judged them as a true giver of judgement [and justice.] This is the first judgement that the Living Spirit gave the rulers [in respect of the] First Man. Indeed, he gave victory to the First Man corresponding to his victory; but he condemned the King of the realms of Darkness corresponding to that by which he had erred.

[And] this chain, of this sort, became [a restraint upon the darkness throughout] the earth till the end time when the universe will be dissolved; and it perishes in the great fire and is separated. While the light goes to its country, the darkness remains in the chain and fetter for ever.

The advent also of the Third Ambassador, when he came to inspect they who are imprisoned in the zone: he is like a great king who comes and inspects craftsmen [and architects] and [artisans] and [all his works.]

Also, they who are good, of the craftsmen and architects and artisans whom he has there in each place: he shall see that they have worked well, and have fallen to his works in their fashion. He shall rejoice with great joy [over them.] He shall thank the artisans who have constructed his works [and completed] his orders.

Now, just as this great king who comes and inspects his works and fortifications, so also is the advent of the Third Ambassador. For, when he too came, he saw [his works] established and prepared and [every] series of the rulers prepared and established there, above and below, outside and within, in the great pattern that his brothers had made. They had come before him to the contest, they who had fixed and created the universe before he came. He saw the gods and the angels established and controlling the fortifications [of heaven and earth,] guarding the entire ruling-power [and order] which his first powers had done. They are the First Man and the Living Spirit and the Great Spirit, the Mother of Life.

The advent also of Jesus the Splendour, the time when he came to all [the elements,] being just like a man if he is sent to pull out a [wild growth and] burn a difficult fig-garden with fire. Therefore, again, when he has first cut the bad trees with his axe and has pulled out [their roots] and their body with his fire, so that they should not return to sprout from this time, nor bear fruit bad to eat [ever again.]
Afterwards, he also planted good plants: the tree of life that will make good fruit.

Again, this is like this simile of the advent of Jesus the Splendour. It happened like this; because he too set out [in] his power and his wisdom, in his [righteous]-ness [as] a king and a saviour [over all things; and] in his glorious wisdom he destroyed them. He bound and crushed them like the fire that shall burn and destroy trees. This is also how he performed his will in the zone, among the many powers, until he reached the form of the flesh of Adam and Eve, the first humans. [He perfected] his will in Eve, he [awakened the knowledge within her.] He also gave hope to Adam, and the good news [of the] glorious [things to come.] He went up to the heights [of the aeons] of light.

Then the summons and the obedience, the great counsel that came to the elements, which are set in conjunction: it mixed with them, it was established in silence. It bears up [all things] until the end time when it can arise and stand firm in the great fire. It will gather to it its own soul, and sculpt it in the Last Statue. You will also find it sweeps out and casts from it the pollution that is foreign to it. However, the life and the light that are in all things it gathers in to it, and builds upon its body.

The time when this Last Statue will be perfect in all its limbs, then it can become free and ascend from that great struggle through the Living Spirit its father, the one who comes and brings a [perfect] limb. He brings it up from within this gathering (?), the melting down and destruction of all things.

Again, this too is what the advent of that thought is like, the counsel of life, which is the summons and obedience that came to the elements. This is the one that at the end can arise and stand firm, and will gather in to it all the lives, and the light that has remained behind in everything. It can build them upon its body; it will gather them in to it [and form them] in its image for ever and ever [without end] from this time.
“[...] the darkness, it was defeated by five greatnesses.

The advent of the Living Spirit is like this, when he was sent from the greatness that he might bring up the First Man. He resembles a judge the king would send to overturn the violence to that man, the noble son against whom his enemies sinned. And he, this judge, [...] hard and cruel [...] and he gives the means [...] by his righteousness and his strength; and he also judges all who are condemned according to their rebellious heart, and repays each according to his deserts. They who are worthy of blows he strikes with hard leather whips. Again, these who are worthy of cutting off their limbs, or indeed their [...] and he repays them accordingly. [...] and he binds and fetters them, and hangs by [...] and thus he does to them with a righteous judgement. And he kills them to flay their skin [...] so that they will be killed by a death [...] until they die. Again, [they for] whom it is fitting [...] to banish from their dwellings he may remove according to a righteous judgement; just as they had faulted and sinned against the noble son.

Now, this counsel, that summons and obedience, resembles thus cooled butter. If a person will take and set it in hot milk, it melts down and soaks in with this hot milk. It melts in another time in silence and quiet to the midst [...] yet also, of the power and the taste of this milk [...] is drawn to (the butter), and (the milk) sets and becomes cold [...] in [...] and the [...] this milk it shall clarify and discard. However, the oil and the grease and the ‘beauty’ of the milk it shall gather in to it.
